Broadcast video and audio consent
Broadcast information we send
We send the broadcast video and audio captured by the camera and microphone to the server. An AI service processes and relays this video and audio for de-identification.
We use this information to distinguish registered faces from other faces and to de-identify other faces in the broadcast video.
Retention and processing

The AI service keeps face feature values in memory during processing. Stored face feature values are deleted when you delete a registered face, when account deletion is completed, or when the AI service is discontinued. Original reference photos are not stored separately.
If you do not consent, the camera and microphone will not be connected to the server. For privacy inquiries or withdrawal of consent, use the contact listed in the Privacy Policy.
Scroll to the end to enable consent.
Agree and continue
YouTube transmission notice

We send the processed broadcast video and audio to the connected YouTube channel. For YouTube connection and broadcasting, we process channel identifiers, encrypted connection tokens, and broadcast connection information.
We send the processed video and audio to the connected YouTube channel and manage the broadcast state.
Processing on YouTube
Video sent to YouTube is processed under YouTube\'s policies and your channel settings. Deleting your InnoLive account does not delete past videos on your YouTube channel.
CHZZK transmission notice

We send the processed broadcast video and audio to the connected CHZZK channel. For CHZZK connection and broadcasting, we process channel, authentication, and broadcast settings and status information.
We send the processed video and audio to the connected CHZZK channel and manage the broadcast state.
Processing on CHZZK
Video sent to CHZZK is processed under CHZZK\'s policies and your channel settings. Deleting your InnoLive account does not delete past videos on your CHZZK channel.
Consent to broadcast video and audio transmission before preparing a broadcast.
Acknowledge the platform transmission notice before preparing a broadcast.
